verdict.rationale: CLAUDE.md is a well-documented first-party feature: a markdown file placed at the project root that Claude Code reads at the start of every session, explicitly used to set coding standards, architecture decisions, preferred libraries, and review checklists. Community evidence also confirms real-world usage (e.g., users expanding their CLAUDE.md files over time). Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of exact behavioral compliance/limits beyond community anecdotes.
